phrases.text: Good morning! Thank you for calling Acme Retail, my name is [REDACTED_NAME]. How can I help you today?
I'm calling about my damaged order [REDACTED_ORDER] and I'd like a refund sent to my email [REDACTED_EMAIL].
I'm so sorry to hear your item arrived damaged, [REDACTED_NAME]. Let me pull up order [REDACTED_ORDER] and send the refund confirmation to [REDACTED_EMAIL].
